simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to נֵדֶה (H5078) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: נֵדֶה (nêdeh) means a bounty (for prostitution) First listed occurrence: Ezek 16 33.

definitions.full: H5078. nedeh נֶ֑דֶה (so Baer Ginsb; van d. H. נֵ֑דֶה ), noun masculine gift (on formation compare Ges § 84a c Ol § 144a Kö ii.1, 65 Ba NB § 12a ); — יִתְּנוּנֶֿ֑דֶה לְכָלזֹֿנוֺת Ezek 16:33 (|| נְדָבִים ).
definitions.rootNote: from 5077 in the sense of freely flinging money;
